hypothesis: A point-in-time, provider-symbol-side triage that separates historical signal evidence, after-cost live translation, concentration, forward paths, and unresolved marks may select a more coherent portfolio successor than aggregate-PnL route ranking.
decision: Refine the successor sequence using two completed negative route-family decisions. Keep v25 unchanged while its current protected lifecycles remain open. For the eventual new source-bound successor generation, retain the three experiment priorities: canonical both-side SOL range onset; the exact ETH pullback route with long/short and aligned/opposed attribution but no Ridge or LightGBM gate; and canonical-pivot SPCX Swing with separate side and entry-episode attribution. Reject the fixed ETH bar-model family and omit the tested SNDK/GOLD/BRENTOIL breakout-pressure transfer family from successor execution. Do not replace them with a broad parameter sweep, global regime veto, static side gate, portfolio-wide profit lock, or leverage increase. Any executable successor still requires a new generation, current implementation backup, flat-and-order-free transition proof, rollback contract, append-only decision, and renewed explicit live-risk authorization.
falsifier: This revision is invalidated by an incorrect predecessor identity, changed evidence bytes, execution authority, open marks counted as closes, or a retired profile represented as launchable. The ETH model exclusion should be revised only if a separately predeclared venue-native route-side model clears stable development ranking and after-cost economics without largest-winner dependence and repeats prospectively. The commodity exclusion should be revised if the intended account execution path demonstrates materially lower fees or a genuinely new predeclared mechanism is positive under nominal and stress standard-fee friction on both sides. The three experiment priorities update when new exact route-side after-cost closes contradict their current evidence.
limitations: This revision adds research-family decisions but no newly resolved v25 lifecycle.
